messages:
anika: FYI I opened a docs PR for a Dedicated quick-migration guide — onboarding reserved pools, per-account quota examples, autoscale cooldowns, and clearer SLA phrasing. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2478. Please do quick copy + snippet sanity checks.

mike: @anika looking now. Can we add a concrete tenant-label example and a minimal autoscale policy snippet showing cooldowns + burst limits? Reviewers hunt for examples first. :eyes:

sara: added a tiny Python SDK snippet in the PR, but verify param names. current snippet I pushed: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$API_KEY")
resp = client.dedicated.create_reservation(tenant_id="acme-corp", gpus=2, region="us-west-2")
print(resp)
```
Is `create_reservation` stable in v0.9.x?

docsbot: CI: docs-lint OK. linkcheck: 1 broken link -> old terraform example (https://github.com/redwood/terraform-examples/blob/master/dedicated/reserved_pool.tf) returned 404 (line ~82).

josh: I'll update the TF path in the PR and add a short note about preemption semantics. Also the isolation sentence could be clearer; replace "isolated by tenant" with "per-account reserved pools provide compute isolation; burst/preemptible capacity may still be reclaimed under pressure."

anika: good. For SLA wording I want something that legal can sign off: option A: "99.9% monthly uptime for Dedicated reserved pools with defined fallback steps" OR option B: "SLA covering availability and latency across committed windows, with documented rollback and fallback behavior." Thoughts?

mike: prefer A for the handbook copy, include B in the runbook with technical fallback sequence. Edit suggestion: change 'best effort' -> 'SLA-backed (99.9% monthly uptime) with documented fallback policy (see /docs/playbooks/dedicated-fallback)'.

sara: confirmed SDK surface — `create_reservation(tenant_id, gpus, region)` exists in v0.9.x. Updated the PR snippet and added a JS example too: ```js
import Redwood from 'redwood-js'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
const res = await client.dedicated.createReservation({ tenantId: 'acme-corp', gpus: 2, region: 'us-west-2' })
console.log(res)
```

josh: pushed TF link fix and added an autoscale sample YAML showing cooldowns + burst cap: ```yaml
autoscalePolicy:
  minInstances: 1
  maxInstances: 10
  scaleUpCooldown: 60s
  scaleDownCooldown: 300s
  maxBurstInstances: 2
```
Also mentioned preemption applies only to burst instances and unreserved pools.

anika: two remaining items before merge: 1) legal sign-off on SLA phrase, 2) infra to verify playbook redirect exists or add one. I'll ping legal and infra. If green, plan to merge this afternoon.
mike: I'll handle the playbook redirect with infra.
sara: pinged legal (cc @legal). tiny copy nit: use 'account' instead of 'tenant' in onboarding steps to reduce confusion.
anika: thanks — updated copy. PR checklist updated with owners: docs (anika), infra (mike), SDK (sara), ops (josh). Merge after legal + infra OKs. :white_check_mark:
